definitions.explanation: A mark or discoloration on fabric or other surfaces.
Spots or marks on the skin, especially from sun exposure or aging.

examples.japanese: {染|し}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|し}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついた→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: I got a stain on my shirt.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{染|し}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{落|お}ちなくて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm having trouble getting the coffee stain out.
I got blemishes on my face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}らないと→塗る：01174_nuru⟧シミ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦やすい→〜やすい：18367_yasui⟧。
examples.english: If you don't apply sunscreen, you'll easily get age spots.
As you get older, age spots can appear on the backs of your hands too.

notes:
{染|し}み has two main meanings: stains on fabric or surfaces, and blemishes or age spots on skin. The word covers any kind of discoloration that shouldn't be there.

COMMON PATTERNS (fabric):
- {染|し}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to get a stain
- {染|し}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to remove a stain
- ⟦{染|し}み{抜|ぬ}き→染み抜き：16791_shiminuki⟧: stain removal
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{染|し}み: bloodstain

SKIN USAGE:
- シミ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to develop age spots
- シミ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: anti-blemish measures
- シミ⟦そばかす→そばかす：16049_sobakasu⟧: spots and freckles

WRITING:
When referring to skin blemishes, シミ is commonly written in katakana, especially in cosmetics and skincare contexts. For fabric stains, both {染|し}み and しみ are used.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {染|し}み: stain, blemish (discoloration)
- ⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧: dirt, grime (general uncleanliness)
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧: scratch, flaw (physical damage)
